title: Bengaluru Police Launch Operation Mukta Against Illegal Immigrants

blocks.content: The Bengaluru City Police launched Operation Mukta on 8 August 2026 to identify and track suspected illegal immigrants across the city. The drive focused on suspected Bangladeshi nationals and involved early-morning raids from around 5:00 AM in multiple localities.
